description: This file defines API routes for managing tasks in a task management backend. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, filtering tasks, and managing associated tags and assignees, utilizing FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic models.

classes.name: TaskTagUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating task tags with a list of tag ids.

classes.name: AssignmentUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating task assignees with a list of user ids.

methods.name: None _project_check(db: Session, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Private function to verify project ownership for a user in a database session.

methods.name: TaskOut create_task(body: TaskCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new task within a project, optionally assigning it to a column.

methods.name: TaskOut get_task(task_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a task by ID and checks user project permissions.

methods.name: TaskOut update_task(task_id: int, body: TaskUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates an existing task's details such as title, description, priority, due date, and column.

methods.name: None delete_task(task_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a task by ID after permission validation.

methods.name: List[TaskOut] list_tasks( projectId: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Project ID"), tags: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Comma-separated tag ids"), assigneeId: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Assignee user id"), priority: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Priority 1-5"), status: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Column id for status"), dueFrom: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Due date from"), dueTo: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Due date to"), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Text search"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Returns a list of tasks filtered by various criteria, including project, tags, assignee, priority, status, dates, and search term.

methods.name: TaskOut replace_task_tags(task_id: int, body: TaskTagUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Replaces all tags of a task with a new set of tag IDs, validating tags belong to the same project.

methods.name: TaskOut replace_assignees(task_id: int, body: AssignmentUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Replaces all assignees of a task with new user IDs after permission validation.
